note: Alphabets are lists of chunks and literals are concatenated in order. Both are split so this spec never contains a contiguous key-shaped run (PEM header, Base58 alphabet). Segment kinds and the source field are documented in recipes.py; rules.json maps every dlp_* rule to its generators.
